Here's a clear side-by-side comparison of the two payments giants:

---

## 💳 Visa vs. Mastercard — Revenue Comparison

| | **Visa (V)** | **Mastercard (MA)** |
|---|---|---|
| **Fiscal Year End** | Sept 30, 2025 | Dec 31, 2025 |
| **Annual Revenue** | **$40.00 billion** | **$32.79 billion** |
| **Filed With SEC** | Nov 6, 2025 | Feb 11, 2026 |

---

### 📊 Key Takeaways

- **Visa leads by ~$7.2 billion**, generating roughly **22% more revenue** than Mastercard in their respective most recent fiscal years.
- Visa's revenue came in at a round **$40.0B**, while Mastercard posted **$32.8B**.
- Mastercard's revenue is approximately **82% the size** of Visa's.

### 🔍 Context to Keep in Mind
*(General background, not from filings)*

- Both companies operate on a **network/fee-based model** — they don't lend money themselves, but collect fees on transactions processed over their networks. Their revenues reflect net fees after rebates and incentives paid to card issuers and merchants.
- Visa has historically maintained a larger **global payment volume**, which explains its revenue premium over Mastercard.
- The two companies have **different fiscal year calendars** (Visa ends in September; Mastercard in December), so these figures cover slightly different time periods.

---

> ⚠️ *This is educational analysis only, not investment advice.*
